what.text: This page follows refugees from Nicaragua living in Honduras, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 155 Nicaraguan refugees in Honduras, 0.4% of all refugees from Nicaragua.
Costa Rica hosts the most Nicaraguan refugees, followed by the United States, Spain and Mexico.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Nicaragua with the FSLN from 1977 to 1979 and with the Contras from 1982 to 1990.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1984 to 1989, fall within the second period.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1978 at 10000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 43000, at the end of 1986 and 1987, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Honduras.
These are year-end totals for Honduras only, reported to UNHCR.
